contexts.text: The reason the wise ones from the Oriental parts offered these things, was that with some in the Oriental parts there had remained from ancient times the knowledge and wisdom of the ancients...
That the science of correspondences had remained with many of the Orientals up to the Lord's Advent, may be evident from the wise ones from the east...
A new religion accommodated to the genius of the Orientals... CL 342:4.

The reason it did not acknowledge the Lord as the God of Heaven and earth, was that the Orientals have acknowledged God the Creator of the universe, and they could not comprehend that He has come into the world and assumed the Human.
The Christian religion... was not accommodated to the genius of the Orientals, as is the Mohammedan religion...
The Orientals, without the permission of polygamy, would have burned with filthy adultery more than Europeans, and would have perished.
